newsitem.title: UK: Japanese stocks in London firm on new confidence.
newsitem.headline: Japanese stocks in London firm on new confidence.

text.p: Japanese stocks in London firmed across the board on Wednesday as buyers looked beyond the main blue-chips and bought a wider range of stocks, traders said.
"There is a feeling that the market is not so vulnerable at the moment," one trader said, "We've seen buyers go out into other areas such as steel and construction companies."

The Nikkei 50 Index in London was at 1,413.50 by 1550 GMT, up 37.58 points or 2.73 percent on Tuesday's London close. Tokyo's Nikkei 225 index closed some 228 points or 1.26 percent higher at 18,409.96.

"Resistance was around 18,500 (in Tokyo) today, but we think the Nikkei 225 may well break through that level in Tokyo tomorrow," one trader said. He added that he didn't think the Nikkei 225 would reach the 19,000 level.
